surfaces.reason: Repository environment recommendation: Plugin declares >=20, but CI configures Node 22 and tests the Web profile; use that stronger repository signal. This is not proof that Node 20 is incompatible. Oversized READMEs are explicitly omitted from bounded evidence; native node-pty build approval is not pre-granted.

Repository environment recommendation: CI configures Node 22. README explicitly installs into --profile web; Web is justified by that instruction, not merely by the remote browser feature. Credential-dependent Cloudflare requests remain outside the smoke-test scope.
